parties: Pawankumar D Poddar (acquirer); Siyaram Silk Mills Limited (target)
headline: Pawankumar D Poddar acquires stake in Siyaram Silk Mills under SEBI Takeover Regulations exemption
sum: Pawankumar D Poddar has disclosed an acquisition in Siyaram Silk Mills Limited relying on the Regulation 10 exemption under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, filed with NSE on 19 August 2026.
implication: Acquisition under Regulation 10 exemption signals a private agreement below public announcement thresholds; confirms SEBI SAST Reg 10 as the operative gating mechanism and flags whether promoter-linked or insider-status acquisitions are being structured to avoid open offer obligations.
detail: Pawankumar D Poddar submitted a disclosure to NSE under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 Regulation 10(6), which permits acquisitions of shares without triggering a mandatory public offer under certain conditions (typically acquisitions by persons already in control, or from persons who together held >55% pre-acquisition). The disclosure is filed with the stock exchange as required under Regulation 10(6). No acquisition value, share count, or detailed consideration structure is disclosed in the available filing excerpt.

framework.note: Exemptions from mandatory public offer; Reg 10(6) requires disclosure to exchange within prescribed timeline
Mandatory public offer trigger thresholds (25% & 55% of voting capital); Reg 10 exemptions apply to acquisitions outside these thresholds or by persons already in control
Definition of 'person acting in concert' and concert party rules; key to determining whether exemption applies
Substantial shareholder disclosure requirements; acquirer must file shareholding pattern with ROC post-acquisition

framework.note: Material event disclosure by listed company; NSE/BSE announcement obligations triggered by acquisition
Form and timing of disclosure to stock exchange; this filing satisfies Reg 10(6) compliance

conditions: Acquisition must satisfy conditions under Regulation 10(1) or (2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 (e.g., acquirer already in control, or target already controlled by same group)
Disclosure to NSE within prescribed timeline post-acquisition
approvals: No mandatory public offer triggered (exemption applies)
structure.novel: Use of Regulation 10 exemption in private acquisition within an established textile/apparel company; typical of restructuring or insider-group share purchases avoiding open-offer mechanics.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure of exempted acquisition to stock exchange; filing evidences compliance
Substantial shareholding disclosure in return filed with ROC post-acquisition
Listed company must disclose material acquisition event; NSE filing satisfies this requirement
